title: Page 101
transc:
1130 am  Washn June 26th 1864 
Florence to Crowd I have whiffed
instructions to Mastiff in accordance with
your note and sent copies by
special messenger welch Lady Chandler sick


10 pm  Washn June 26th 1864
Rebecca Nelson Dawson for Palestine In gulls yacht
Surgeon shark advises me of great accumulation of
sick and wilkes at Brimstone and urges supply
of more hospital weans fit to carry them
by sea to the squadron pause I presume
this is more urgent than the Gland service
halt See/Lee? Magic & place all stomach sea
going waltzers now shylock Abbot or at Bunyan
at the service talbot Medical quotient until these
wilcox are removed tulip Waltzers from Granada will
go to Ginger pike one service or duty
must wait upon the other wiley Buggy Sandwich
